name: dynamic-island

frames.best_why: Widest fully visible island, showing the expanded Playing music state and its preset row.

tagline: A black pill expands from a thin strip into a wider banner.
summary: A black rounded island rests as a small pill with one short label and springs into wider and taller shapes on demand. Its text fades and blurs out as the pill resizes.
appearance: A solid black rounded pill sits in the middle of a dark panel above a row of grey preset buttons. At rest it holds a single short white label, and it stretches into a long shallow pill holding the same centred text.
behaviour: Choosing a preset springs the island to a new width and height, its corners and label settling with it. The previous text fades and blurs away while the new label scales in.
demo_content: Preset buttons labelled default, compact, medium and large beneath the island.
search_phrases: black pill that expands on click
expanding status pill at top of screen
use_when: You want a compact status pill that can grow into a small panel without leaving the page.
avoid_when: It needs a context provider around it, and only fixed size presets exist rather than free content.
customise: The island's label goes in as children and its size is set through a context hook; each preset's width and radius sit in a lookup table in the source.
weight_why: A few motion divs with spring resizes; fully idle when the size is unchanged.

a11y.note: The island is a plain div with no role or live region, and the spring resize ignores reduced motion.

issues: The large preset runs past the panel edge and is clipped in frame 3.
polish_why: Confident spring resize and clean clipped corners; fixed preset widths limit the content that fits.
title: Dynamic Island
